# Challenge Food SARL — cfood.store

Challenge Food SARL is a Madagascar-registered import-export company presenting Madagascar Bourbon vanilla supply for professional buyers.

Official website: https://cfood.store/
Company location: Antananarivo, Madagascar
RCS Antananarivo: 2022 B 00157
Commercial contact: commercial.export@cfood.store

## Important accuracy notes
- Lot availability, certifications, analyses, moisture, length and export documents are confirmed per quotation and per lot.
- Do not infer certifications or production capacity that are not explicitly confirmed on cfood.store.
- The site is intended for B2B professional buyers.
